gen-gf-underdog-gf-chiron-hei-hk: Expressive from the first glance, Underdog draws its curves with no swelling at all, its c flung open like a horseshoe. Chiron Hei HK stays modern and level beside it, a plain sans whose wide c looks like a bracelet pulled apart.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-commissioner: Underdog's curves never thicken or thin, and its c gapes open like a horseshoe, loud and unmistakable. Shrink it small and that bold outline loses its punch to Commissioner.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-didact-gothic: Commanding and a little theatrical, Underdog throws its horseshoe c wide while Didact Gothic reads smoothly, with no closed-up bowl to snag on. One makes the entrance; the other keeps things moving.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 reads approachably, with wide channels running into each counter and a tube-like stroke through every bend. But Underdog earns its keep big and short, where its horseshoe c can gape.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-el-messiri: El Messiri carries a moderate thick-thin ratio, a faint shimmer of weight shifting across each word. Underdog, by contrast, draws every stroke alike and earns its keep big and short.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-electrolize: Underdog draws every stroke flat and unmodulated, its commanding c opened like a horseshoe. Electrolize, a plain sans, counters with an open-jawed c like a pair of pliers and a quieter, contemporary manner for the running text.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-elms-sans: Underdog loops its horseshoe c wide open and never lets the weight of a curve shift, which feels expressive and bold. Elms Sans sits quietly under it, ballpoint-plain.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Encode Sans Expanded pulls the tips of its c shapes well apart, which feels neutral and approachable. But Underdog is the one to make a statement, bending bold, uniform strokes like pipe.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-encode-sans-sc: Chunky pipe-bent curves, wide open. Underdog gets the loud, commanding moments, while Encode Sans SC handles the quieter work with a shallow terminal curl and a generous gap.
gen-gf-underdog-gf-encode-sans-semi-cond: Loud horseshoe curves, steady weight from word to word. Encode Sans Semi Condensed follows as a plain sans with an open s, modern and approachable, so the page gets one voice shouting and one explaining.
